description: Shared Renovate preset for the homelab-selfuryon org. Use as: local>homelab-selfuryon/.github

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Security fixes skip the minimumReleaseAge soak and the hourly limit.

lockFileMaintenance.description: Weekly refresh of Cargo.lock (no Nix flakes in the org).

customManagers.description: CUE module dependencies on org modules: "github.com/homelab-selfuryon/<repo>@v0": { v: "vX.Y.Z" } in cue.mod/module.cue.
Component versions in platform-components registry/latest.json. Each entry names its Renovate datasource and package; helm entries also carry the repository URL.
devenv version used by the reusable workflows (DEVENV_VERSION: vX.Y.Z)

packageRules.description: Pin every GitHub Action and reusable workflow (including the org's github-workflows) to a commit SHA.
Automerge minor, patch, pin and digest updates once the required checks are green; majors wait for a human.
0.x versions treat a minor bump as breaking: no automerge.
Group the org's own reusable workflow bumps so a release of github-workflows lands as one PR.
Container base images (Containerfile/Dockerfile) are pinned by digest; digest-only updates automerge, version bumps follow the general rules.
